title: Inversion for Effect
completion_message: ¡Magistral! La 'Inversión' es quizás la estructura gramatical más literaria y dramática del inglés. Usarla en un discurso o ensayo te otorga una autoridad y elocuencia que pocos hablantes no nativos logran alcanzar.

parts.visual:
En inglés muy formal, literario o para discursos, usamos la 'Inversión' para dar énfasis dramático. 
Si comenzamos una oración con una palabra NEGATIVA o RESTRICTIVA (Rarely, Never, Little, Under no circumstances), debemos INVERTIR el sujeto y el verbo auxiliar (como si fuera una pregunta). 

1. Never / Rarely / Seldom (Nunca / Rara vez): 
Normal: I have never seen such incompetence. 
Inversion: NEVER HAVE I seen such incompetence. 

2. Little (Poco / No saber): 
Normal: We knew little about the danger. 
Inversion: LITTLE DID WE KNOW about the danger. (Usamos 'did' como auxiliar del pasado).
parts.audio: Welcome to Inversion for Dramatic Effect. In highly formal English, speeches, or literature, we use inversion for emphasis. If we start a sentence with a negative or restrictive word, we must invert the subject and the auxiliary verb, exactly as if we were asking a question. Number 1: Never, Rarely, or Seldom. Normal sentence: I have never seen such incompetence. Inverted for drama: NEVER HAVE I seen such incompetence. Number 2: Little, which implies not knowing. Normal: We knew little about the danger. Inverted: LITTLE DID WE KNOW about the danger. Notice we had to add the auxiliary 'did'.

parts.visual:
3. Not only... but also (No solo... sino también): 
Normal: He didn't only lose the client, but he also insulted them. 
Inversion: NOT ONLY DID HE LOSE the client, but he also insulted them. 

4. Under no circumstances (Bajo ninguna circunstancia): 
Normal: You should not sign this contract under any circumstances. 
Inversion: UNDER NO CIRCUMSTANCES SHOULD YOU sign this contract. 

5. Only then / Only later (Solo entonces / Solo más tarde): 
Normal: I realized my mistake only later. 
Inversion: ONLY LATER DID I REALIZE my mistake. 

Nota: Si no hay auxiliar en la oración original (presente o pasado simple), usa do/does/did.
parts.audio: Number 3: Not only... but also. Normal: He didn't only lose the client, but he also insulted them. Inverted: NOT ONLY DID HE LOSE the client, but he also insulted them. Number 4: Under no circumstances. Normal: You should not sign this contract under any circumstances. Inverted: UNDER NO CIRCUMSTANCES SHOULD YOU sign this contract. Number 5: Only then, or Only later. Normal: I realized my mistake only later. Inverted: ONLY LATER DID I REALIZE my mistake. Remember, if there is no auxiliary verb in the original sentence, you must add do, does, or did, just like making a question.

questions.question: Normal: I have never heard such a ridiculous excuse. -> Inversion: Never ____ such a ridiculous excuse.
questions.explanation: Inversión con auxiliar 'have': Never have I heard.

questions.question: Normal: They rarely complain about the workload. -> Inversion: Rarely ____ about the workload.
questions.explanation: Presente simple necesita 'do': Rarely do they complain.

questions.question: Normal: We knew little about the financial problems. -> Inversion: Little ____ about the financial problems.
questions.explanation: Pasado simple necesita 'did': Little did we know.

questions.question: Normal: You should not open this file under any circumstances. -> Inversion: Under no circumstances ____ this file.
questions.explanation: Inversión del modal 'should': Under no circumstances should you open.

questions.question: Normal: He not only stole the money, but he also lied. -> Inversion: Not only ____ the money, but he also lied.
questions.explanation: Pasado simple necesita 'did': Not only did he steal.

questions.question: Normal: I understood the plan only later. -> Inversion: Only later ____ the plan.
questions.explanation: Pasado simple necesita 'did': Only later did I understand.

questions.question: Normal: I had hardly arrived when it started raining. -> Inversion: Hardly ____ when it started raining.
questions.explanation: Pasado perfecto usa 'had': Hardly had I arrived.

questions.question: Normal: You will not find a better deal anywhere. -> Inversion: Nowhere ____ a better deal.
questions.explanation: Inversión con modal 'will': Nowhere will you find.

questions.question: Normal: I realized the truth only then. -> Inversion: Only then ____ the truth.
questions.explanation: Pasado simple necesita 'did': Only then did I realize.

questions.question: Normal: She is not only brilliant, but she is also hardworking. -> Inversion: Not only ____ brilliant, but she is also hardworking.
questions.explanation: Inversión del verbo 'to be': Not only is she.

questions.question: Normal: The CEO seldom visits the factory. -> Inversion: Seldom ____ the factory.
questions.explanation: Presente simple (he/she/it) necesita 'does': Seldom does the CEO visit.

questions.question: Normal: I had no sooner closed the door than the phone rang. -> Inversion: No sooner ____ the door than the phone rang.
questions.explanation: Pasado perfecto usa 'had': No sooner had I closed.

questions.question: Normal: You cannot leave the building on any account. -> Inversion: On no account ____ the building.
questions.explanation: Inversión con modal 'can': On no account can you leave.

questions.question: Normal: The manager did not apologize once. -> Inversion: Not once ____.
questions.explanation: Pasado simple usa 'did': Not once did the manager apologize.

questions.question: Normal: I have seldom seen such a beautiful painting. -> Inversion: Seldom ____ such a beautiful painting.
questions.explanation: Presente perfecto usa 'have': Seldom have I seen.

questions.question: Normal: The team not only won the match, but they also broke the record. -> Inversion: Not only ____ the match, but they also broke the record.
questions.explanation: Pasado simple usa 'did': Not only did the team win.

questions.question: Normal: I will never make that mistake again. -> Inversion: Never again ____ that mistake.
questions.explanation: Inversión del modal 'will': Never again will I make.

questions.question: Normal: We expected little help from the government. -> Inversion: Little ____ from the government.
questions.explanation: Pasado simple usa 'did': Little did we expect.

questions.question: Normal: You must not press this button under any condition. -> Inversion: Under no condition ____ this button.
questions.explanation: Inversión del modal 'must': Under no condition must you press.

questions.question: ¿Qué oración usa la inversión de manera incorrecta?
options: Rarely he goes to the office.
Rarely does he go to the office.
questions.correct_answer: Rarely he goes to the office.
questions.explanation: Incorrecta: Falta el auxiliar 'does'. Debería ser 'Rarely does he go'.

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe el auxiliar de inversión (have, did, do, does, will, is, etc).

questions.question: Never ____ I seen such a thing! (Present perfect)
questions.explanation: have.

questions.question: Little ____ we know about the risk. (Past simple)
questions.explanation: did.

questions.question: Not only ____ he lose the money, but he also lied. (Past simple)
questions.explanation: did.

questions.question: Under no circumstances ____ you sign that! (Modal)
questions.explanation: should.

questions.question: Rarely ____ they complain. (Present simple, they)
questions.explanation: do.

questions.question: Seldom ____ the boss smile. (Present simple, the boss)
questions.explanation: does.

questions.question: Nowhere ____ you find a better price! (Modal de futuro)
questions.explanation: will.

questions.question: Only later ____ she understand the problem. (Past simple)
questions.explanation: did.

questions.question: Not only ____ she brilliant, she is also kind. (Verbo To Be presente)
questions.explanation: is.

questions.question: Hardly ____ I arrived when it rained. (Past perfect)
questions.explanation: had.

pairs.target: Solo más tarde me di cuenta
Ni una sola vez se disculpó
